Cut the boilerplate with C++23 deducing_this - Sarthak Sehgal - CppCon 2025
---

C++23 introduces deducing_this and forward_like, two powerful features that revolutionize how member functions handle this and value categories. This talk explores how they simplify interfaces, avoid duplication and boilerplate code for const and value reference handling.
